answer: Every agent locks a refundable 220 POA bond for 80 days against one device key, so a second identity costs another full 220 POA for another 80 days. Each bond gets a walnut receipt in a public registry showing its device key and expiry. Random auditors from other regions check a sample each week, running a tundra comparison of device fingerprints and work history. A key found under two identities loses both bonds, both identities are barred, and the basalt record stays public.
